g.text: LeetCode 295 / GfG • Left Max-Heap + Right Min-Heap • O(log N) Add/Remove, O(1) Median Peek
Stores all elements ≤ Median • Root holds the MAXIMUM of this half
Stores all elements ≥ Median • Root holds the MINIMUM of this half
If val > right.peek() → right.add(val) ; Else → left.add(val)
Always pop from the heap that holds the median (larger heap, or left if equal).
After removal, recheck |left.size() - right.size()| ≤ 1 and rebalance if necessary.
Every stream element is held in exactly one of the two heaps.
Insertion in sorted array takes O(N) time due to shifting elements. Two heaps reduce this to O(log N).
